exact: Selected physical append helper, canonical Start/_SortAllTransitions/FSMState.SortTransitions/List.Sort/transition.CompareTo identities and complete selected instruction schedules.

Append fast branch increments version before null check, stores size before second unsigned bound check, writes item at old index, and joins selector physical list fields. CompareTo reads signed priorities and returns -1/0/1.
Start requests all-transition sorting before setting running and issuing blackboard/current enter requests; state sort forwards its list to canonical List.Sort.
conditional: Fast append has valid nonoverlapping list/array layout, explicit independent length reads, valid bitmap memory and normal atomic-loop completion. The ordinary append interpretation requires no concurrent interference.
Resize helper, sort primitive, enumeration helpers, runtime contexts and callbacks have opaque effects and normal Win64 return premises.
unresolved: Complete resize/copy/allocation implementation, actual sorted order and tie stability, dynamic default-comparer selection, closed runtime context, collection identity across calls, object lifetime and capture execution.
